items.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996
items.q: And everybody was leaving, and Jimmy Lyon said, “Hold it, hold it, we’re not through.” And they called me in

ctx.x: So there you are at the Monterey Jazz Festival with some pretty good sidemen.

You know the funny thing about that night, the audience didn’t know I was there. They found me in Newport, Kentucky. So I wasn’t even on the bill. And everybody was leaving, and Jimmy Lyon said, “Hold it, hold it, we’re not through.” And they called me in, and I was with some insignificant musicians by the name of Ben Webster, who else
was there, Bobby Brookmeyer, Roy Eldridge, Woody Herman, Coleman Hawkins, Earl Hines. What can you say?
